# ankra_security_evidence_destination (Resource)

A compliance evidence destination (`ankra security evidence destinations`): a Vanta document, a Wazuh relay or a signed webhook that security evidence deliveries are sent to. The credential is write-only (Terraform 1.11 or later): it goes to the platform's secret store and never reaches plan or state. The platform cannot change a destination, so any change, including a new `credential_wo_version`, replaces it. Destroy revokes the destination: it is disabled, its credential deleted and its undelivered deliveries cancelled, and its record stays for the history. Sending deliveries stays imperative (`ankra security evidence deliveries send`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_security_evidence_destination" "siem" {
  name                  = "wazuh-relay"
  kind                  = "webhook"
  config                = { url = "https://siem.example.com/evidence" }
  credential_wo         = { signing_secret = var.evidence_signing_secret }
  credential_wo_version = 1
}

variable "evidence_signing_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `config` (Attributes) Where evidence goes. Addresses must be `https`. Changing it replaces the destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `credential_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The destination's credential, such as a Vanta OAuth client or a webhook signing secret, as a write-only attribute.
- `credential_wo_version` (Number) Version of `credential_wo`. Terraform cannot see a change to a write-only value, so change this to store a new credential; that replaces the destination.
- `kind` (String) `vanta`, `wazuh` or `webhook`. Changing it replaces the destination.
- `name` (String) Destination name. Changing it replaces the destination.

### Read-Only

- `credential_configured` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds the destination's credential.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives deliveries.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the destination.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `api_base_url` (String) Vanta API base address.
- `document_id` (String) Vanta document the evidence is attached to.
- `url` (String) Wazuh relay or webhook address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by destination id. The credential is never read back.
terraform import ankra_security_evidence_destination.siem 4c5d6e7f-8091-4a22-9b3c-4d5e6f7a8b9c
```
